title: Environment Setup for Model Evaluation and Perceptrons
description: Import NumPy, Matplotlib, and scikit-learn splitting, preprocessing, model, and evaluation tools, then fix the random seed and plot defaults.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Import `math`, `numpy`, `matplotlib.pyplot`, and scikit-learn utilities for data splitting (`train_test_split`, `KFold`, `StratifiedKFold`, `cross_val_score`), feature scaling and polynomials, pipelines, and linear/logistic models.

Import regression and classification evaluation metrics (`mean_squared_error`, `r2_score`, `confusion_matrix`, `roc_curve`, `auc`, and display helpers) along with `make_regression` and `load_breast_cancer`.
Set NumPy's random seed to the supplied value for reproducible splits and synthetic datasets, configure Matplotlib figure size `(6, 4)` and axes grid, and print `'Environment ready.'`.

Notice how line 7 groups the data-splitting tools while lines 11-16 group the evaluation metrics, and line 19 seeds NumPy's random number generator so every subsequent cell uses repeatable random draws.

steps.question: What does this setup cell print to the console when executed?
steps.answer: It prints `Environment ready.` after loading all modules and setting the random seed and Matplotlib defaults.
